item.description: Excavations at Westminster Abbey have unveiled a medieval abbot's remains within an ancient Roman coffin, dated to the time between AD 987 and 1052. item.description: Hay un dicho francés que reza «No hay humo sin fuego» . A menudo se utiliza de forma poco científica, hasta el punto de que, en ocasiones, sustenta razonamientos conspiracionistas, que ven en una correlación fortuita el indicio de una causalidad activa. item.title: Acupuncture and mutual exchange in Chinese and Soviet science
item.description: Previous accounts of the scientific relationship between communist China and the Soviet Union have depicted it as one of subordination, with the Russians exporting knowledge to the Chinese or scavenging from their bodies of knowledge. A new article in Isis, however, posits that the relationship between Chinese and Soviet scientists was instead one of mutual exchange. In "Brief Encounter: Acupuncture, Pavlov, and Scientific Exchange Between China and the Soviet Union, 1949-1961," authors Liang Wan, Simon Huxtable and Sarah Marks explore the role of acupuncture in uniting the Pavlovian science… Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Supramolecular assembly opens a new route to building quantum materials
item.description: A joint research team fabricated a two-dimensional structure that exhibits properties of both the honeycomb and Kagome lattices using organic molecules. They discovered that edge states specific to topological materials (states that exist only at the edges and are distinct from those in the interior) appear in this structure. The team included researchers from NIMS, Toyota Kosen (National Institute of Technology, Toyota College), Saga University, Nara Women's University, Kiel University (Germany) and other institutions. Fuente: Phys.org.

Y no la presentó como una ocurrencia propia, sino como un consejo que, según contó, había recibido de especialistas. La conversación surgió este jueves a partir de una broma.
